entries.summary: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
entries.message: braces@3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) has no fixed release; it is a development-only dependency of the q9 gates through micromatch and never ships in the web or Convex bundles. Remove when braces publishes a fix.

entries.summary: deepmerge mergeObject() allows prototype poisoning of returned objects
entries.message: deepmerge@4.3.1 (GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4): deepmerge publishes no fixed 4.x release. It is a build-time dependency of the Expo CLI and never ships in the phone, web or Convex bundles. Remove when the Expo or eslint toolchain moves to a fixed release.

entries.summary: Glob: AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal
entries.message: glob@13.0.6 (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4): the fix needs glob 14, a major version the Expo CLI does not accept. It is a build-time dependency of the Expo CLI and never ships in the phone, web or Convex bundles. Remove when the Expo or eslint toolchain moves to a fixed release.

entries.summary: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
entries.message: minimatch@10.2.6 (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249): the fix needs minimatch 11, a major version eslint does not accept. It is a development-only dependency of react-doctor through eslint and never ships in the phone, web or Convex bundles. Remove when the Expo or eslint toolchain moves to a fixed release.

entries.summary: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
entries.message: zod@3.25.76 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5): the fix needs zod 4. It is a build-time dependency of the Expo CLI and never ships in the phone, web or Convex bundles. Remove when the Expo or eslint toolchain moves to a fixed release.
